# Asana Lodge

> > Asana Lodge is a residential addiction treatment and dual diagnosis rehab provider offering evidence-based therapies including CBT, NAD+ therapy, and comprehensive recovery programs across multiple UK locations and Spain.

Asana Lodge specializes in treating substance addictions (alcohol, cannabis, cocaine, MDMA, ketamine) and behavioral addictions (sex, love, pornography) alongside co-occurring mental health conditions. The facility provides educational resources on drug safety, substance effects, and recovery support for individuals seeking evidence-based addiction treatment.

## Key Topics

- Addiction Treatment
- Dual Diagnosis
- Residential Rehab
- Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT)
- Detoxification
- Mental Health
- Substance Abuse Recovery
- Cannabis & THC/CBD
- Alcohol Rehabilitation
- Drug Education & Safety
- Behavioral Addictions
- NAD+ Therapy
- Aftercare Programs
- UK Treatment Locations
- Party Drugs (MDMA, Ketamine, 2C-B)

## Substance Education & Safety

- [What Is Pink Cocaine? Everything You Need To Know](https://asanalodge.com/what-is-pink-cocaine-everything-you-need-to-know): Educational article on pink cocaine (2C-B), its effects and health dangers
- [Is Cannabis a Depressant?](https://asanalodge.com/is-cannabis-a-depressant): Educational guide on cannabis classification as depressant and stimulant
- [What's the Difference Between Weed and Skunk?](https://asanalodge.com/whats-the-difference-between-weed-and-skunk): Explains cannabis strains, THC/CBD differences between weed and skunk
- [The Effects of Cannabis Edibles: What You Need to Know](https://asanalodge.com/the-effects-of-cannabis-edibles-what-you-need-to-know): Safety guide on THC/CBD edibles, delayed onset and dosing risks
